get.description: Gets the names of the live datasets. Only the clp-s storage engine is supported.

200.description: The datasets' names, ordered by name

400.description: The package's storage engine isn't clp-s

post.description: Creates a dataset, whose archives are stored at its location in the package's archive output. Only the clp-s storage engine is supported.

400.description: The request body isn't valid JSON, or the package's storage engine isn't clp-s

409.description: A dataset with the same name already exists, possibly pending deletion

422.description: The request body doesn't match the schema, including when `name` is missing or isn't a valid dataset name, `retention_period_minutes` isn't a positive 32-bit integer, or the body has an unknown field

delete.description: Marks a live dataset as deleted. Its archives are deleted from the archive storage afterwards, in the background. Only the clp-s storage engine is supported.

202.description: The dataset was marked as deleted

400.description: Invalid dataset name, or the package's storage engine isn't clp-s

404.description: There's no live dataset with the name

get.description: Gets a live dataset's live archives whose timestamp ranges lie within the given time range. Only the clp-s storage engine is supported.

parameters.name: begin_timestamp_millisecs
parameters.description: The time range's lower bound (inclusive), in epoch milliseconds. Omit for no lower bound.

parameters.name: end_timestamp_millisecs
parameters.description: The time range's upper bound (inclusive), in epoch milliseconds. Omit for no upper bound.

200.description: The archives, in no particular order

400.description: Invalid dataset name or query parameters (e.g., `begin_timestamp_millisecs` > `end_timestamp_millisecs`), or the package's storage engine isn't clp-s

404.description: There's no live dataset with the name

post.description: Marks a live dataset's live archives as deleted, selected either by their IDs or by a time range that their timestamp ranges lie within. When selecting by IDs, no archive is marked unless every ID is the ID of a live archive of the dataset. The archives are deleted from the archive storage afterwards, in the background. Only the clp-s storage engine is supported.

200.description: The IDs of the marked archives

400.description: Invalid dataset name; the request body isn't valid JSON; `begin_timestamp_millisecs` > `end_timestamp_millisecs`; or the package's storage engine isn't clp-s

404.description: There's no live dataset with the name, with no body; or some of the requested IDs aren't the IDs of live archives of the dataset, with those IDs in the body

422.description: The request body doesn't match the schema, including when it has both or neither of `archive_ids` and the time range, only one of the time range's bounds, an invalid archive ID, or an unknown field

200.description: The URI to fetch the results of the submitted query.

400.description: Invalid query config (e.g., empty query_string, time_range_begin_millisecs > time_range_end_millisecs, count_by_time_bucket_size_millisecs <= 0)

delete.description: Cancels a previously submitted query job.

200.description: The cancellation request was submitted successfully.

404.description: No query job with the given ID was found.

409.description: The query job with the given ID has terminated without being cancelled.

get.description: Streams the results of a previously submitted query as Server-Sent Events (SSE).

parameters.name: raw_docs
parameters.description:
When `true`, each SSE event contains the raw result document from the results cache
serialized as JSON (including metadata such as the timestamp and the original file path);
otherwise, each event contains only the log message. Only applies to query jobs whose
results are buffered in `MongoDB`.

parameters.name: sorted

200.description: Server-Sent Events stream of query results. Each event contains a single line of the query result in JSON format.

404.description: No query job with the given ID was found.

409.description: The query job streamed its results to a network listener, so they aren't stored.

get.description: Gets resource usage statistics for compression jobs within the given time range.

parameters.name: time_range_begin_millisecs
parameters.description: Start of usage window (epoch milliseconds, inclusive).

parameters.name: time_range_end_millisecs
parameters.description: End of usage window (epoch milliseconds, exclusive).

parameters.name: job_status
parameters.description:
Job statuses to include as a comma-separated list (e.g.
`job_status=succeeded,failed`). Recognized values (case-insensitive):
`PENDING`, `RUNNING`, `SUCCEEDED`, `FAILED`.
Defaults to `SUCCEEDED,FAILED` (all terminal states).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of jobs to return. Must be > 0; defaults to 1000.

400.description: Invalid query parameters (e.g., time_range_begin_millisecs > time_range_end_millisecs, missing required fields)

begin_timestamp_millisecs.description:
The inclusive lower bound of the archive's timestamps, in epoch milliseconds, or `0` if it
has no timestamps.

end_timestamp_millisecs.description:
The inclusive upper bound of the archive's timestamps, in epoch milliseconds, or `0` if it
has no timestamps.

ArchiveSelection.description:
Request body for the archive deletion endpoint, which selects the archives to delete either by
their IDs or by a time range.

ArchiveTimeRangeSelection.description: A time range that archives' timestamp ranges lie within.

begin_timestamp_millisecs.description: The time range's lower bound (inclusive), in epoch milliseconds.

end_timestamp_millisecs.description: The time range's upper bound (inclusive), in epoch milliseconds.

CompressionUsage.description: Resource usage statistics for the compression job with the specified ID.

compressed_size_bytes.description: Total compressed archive size, in bytes.

duration_secs.description: Wall-clock duration the job ran, in seconds. Absent if the job did not complete.

num_tasks.description: Number of tasks the job was split into.

tasks_duration_secs.description: Sum of all task durations, in seconds. Absent if no tasks reported a duration.

time_begin_millisecs.description: Time the job started executing (epoch milliseconds).

time_creation_millisecs.description: Time the job was created (epoch milliseconds).

uncompressed_size_bytes.description: Total uncompressed size of input files, in bytes.

DatasetCreation.description: Request body for the dataset creation endpoint.

retention_period_minutes.description:
How long the dataset's archives are kept after their creation, in minutes. Must be
positive. Omit or set to `null` to keep them forever.

QueryConfig.description: Defines the request configuration for submitting a search query.

buffer_results_in_mongodb.description:
Whether to buffer search results in `MongoDB`.
By default, search results are buffered in temporary files. When set to `true`, results
will be stored in `MongoDB` instead.

count_by_time_bucket_size_millisecs.description:
The size of each time bucket (in milliseconds) for count-by-time aggregation.
When set, the job is submitted as a count-by-time aggregation job instead of a plain
search job, and its results are always buffered in `MongoDB`.

datasets.description: The datasets to search within. If not provided, only `default` dataset will be searched.

ignore_case.description: Whether the string match should be case-insensitive.

max_num_results.description: The maximum number of results to return. Omit for no limit.

query_string.description: The search query as a KQL string.

time_range_begin_millisecs.description: The beginning timestamp (in epoch milliseconds) for the search range (inclusive).

time_range_end_millisecs.description: The ending timestamp (in epoch milliseconds) for the search range (inclusive).

query_results_uri.description: The uri to get the query results.
